meta.title: Price watch
meta.description: Watch flight prices: without fixed dates a Calendar monitor keeps the next 380 days of lowest fares, and pinning a day turns it into a Watch; with fixed dates a Watch collects the real flights and each passenger's tax-included fare at the rhythm you pick (30 min to 24 h) — Ctrip sign-in required. Price alerts and the daily digest are pushed to Feishu.
